messages:
Morgan: Noticed odd KMS activity for key wrap-legacy in Cloud Audit Logs. Principals that don't match active svcaccs.

Raj: Yikes. Can you share the log query?

Morgan: Using gcloud logging read with resource.type=cloud_kms_crypto_key and filtering cryptoKeyName + timeframe. Quick example:```gcloud logging read \"resource.type=cloud_kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.resourceName:wrap-legacy AND timestamp>\"2025-10-30T00:00:00Z\"\" --format=json | jq '.[] | {t:.timestamp,actor:.protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail,method:.protoPayload.methodName}'```

Morgan: Sample sanitized hits:
- 2025-10-31T11:02:03Z legacy-agent@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com Encrypt
- 2025-10-31T11:05:10Z unknown-runner@ci.gserviceaccount.com Decrypt

Ana: We rotated wrap-legacy -> wrap-current two months ago. Those principals shouldn't be calling it. Could be leftover IAM bindings or partner tokens.

Sam: Plan: 1) enumerate key IAM bindings, 2) map principals to identity directory, 3) remove orphaned bindings only, 4) monitor logs + apps for 2h, 5) schedule rewrap for any remaining ciphertexts.

Raj: Commands to run:```gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy wrap-legacy --location=global --keyring=wrap-keys --project=redwood-prod --format=json```and removal:```gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding wrap-legacy --location=global --keyring=wrap-keys --member='serviceAccount:legacy-agent@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter' --project=redwood-prod```

Ana: Also check Vault transit mounts and any Vault metadata pointing to wrap-legacy:```vault list sys/mounts || vault read transit/keys/wrap-legacy```If Vault is configured to use it, update mount config to wrap-current before changing IAM.

Morgan: Found two Vault mounts referencing wrap-legacy: backup/ and team/audit. I'll open a small infra PR to switch backup/ to wrap-current.

vault-bot: Indexer: 412 KMS events for wrap-legacy indexed for 2025-10-30..2025-10-31. Use `/audit query kms wrap-legacy` to inspect.

Sam: Good. Raj, please prepare the exact revoke commands and a dry-run script listing affected objects (GCS) that indicate SSE-KMS usage. We'll avoid breaking CI.

Raj: Noted. GCS check example: `gsutil ls -L -r gs://backups/** | grep -E \"KMS key:.*wrap-legacy\"` For objects, plan rewrite with `gsutil rewrite -sse-kms-key=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/wrap-keys/cryptoKeys/wrap-current gs://backups/...` Keep copies until verification.

Ana: Security question: should we create new key material (wrap-new) and rewrap immediately, or just migrate consumers to wrap-current then retire wrap-legacy?

Sam: Prefer migrate -> revoke -> deprecate. Creating new key material now risks more complexity. Only create wrap-new if consumers can't update.

Morgan: Agreement: no immediate new key. Steps: Morgan -> PR for Vault mounts (ETA 90m). Raj -> IAM enumeration + revoke script (ETA 45m). Ana -> BQ query to list any non-org principals hitting key and start partner outreach (ETA 3h). Sam -> coordinate revoke and monitor. sre-oncall -> add Grafana panel for KMS errors and a staging synthetic.

sre-oncall: I'll add a dashboard panel and an alert threshold for Decrypt/Encrypt error spikes.

Raj: Also checking IAM Conditions: ensure there isn't an impersonation path (iam.serviceAccounts.actAs) that would allow lateral use. I'll audit roles/iam.allow policies across project folder.

Sam: Link runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-orphaned-grants (revoke checklist, verification commands, rollback). Post changes to ticket SEC-2025-412.

Morgan: Will post revoke command in the ticket before execution and wait for the +1 from Sam. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
